entries.name: Water Bottle
entries.summary: Fill a clean glass bottle from an adjacent water source.

sections.heading: Where it comes from
paragraphs: Alchemy Stand: Water Bottle.

sections.heading: How to make it
paragraphs: Alchemy Stand: 1 x Empty Glass Bottle, 1 x water source produces 1 x Water Bottle. Fill a clean glass bottle from an adjacent water source.

sections.heading: What it makes
paragraphs: Alchemy Stand: 1 x Water Bottle, 2 x Wild Apple, 1 x Moonberry produces 1 x Wild Apple Remedy. A bright restorative draught with familiar orchard sweetness.
Alchemy Stand: 1 x Water Bottle, 1 x Cave Gel, 1 x Wild Wheat, 1 x Glow Scale produces 1 x Gloamstep Elixir. Goblin cavecraft for low-light sight and sure underground footing.
Alchemy Stand: 1 x Water Bottle, 1 x Wild Apple, 1 x Wildflower Honey, 1 x Cloudbell produces 1 x Hearthward Tonic. Hobbit herbcraft that wards cold and softens incoming harm.
Distillery: 2 x Water Bottle, 3 x Wildflower Honey, 2 x Wild Wheat produces 4 x Bottle of Honeymead. Slow-fermented honeymead, bottled four at a time.

Alchemy Stand: 1 x Water Bottle, 4 x Raw Gold, 1 x Fire Dragon Heart or Fire Dragon Heart or Ice Dragon Heart or Steel Dragon Heart or Sea Dragon Heart or Gold Dragon Heart or Silver Dragon Heart produces 1 x Manaheart Draught. Raw gold steadies the enduring spark drawn from any elemental dragon heart.
Alchemy Stand: 1 x Water Bottle, 2 x Marshmallow Tuft, 1 x Wildflower Honey produces 1 x Marshmallow Ward. Honey suspends a soft marshmallow charm that cushions harm and knockback.
Alchemy Stand: 1 x Water Bottle, 2 x Moonpetal, 1 x Dreamcap produces 1 x Moonstep Elixir. Moonpetal and Dreamcap lend quiet speed beneath starlight and dense canopy.
Alchemy Stand: 1 x Water Bottle, 2 x Peppermint Cane, 1 x Wild Gumdrop produces 1 x Peppermint Rush. Ribbon-bright mint and a wild gumdrop lend quick feet without shortening the road ahead.
Alchemy Stand: 1 x Water Bottle, 2 x Lumen Kelp Frond, 1 x Abyss Bloom Nectar produces 1 x Tidebreath Philter. Lumen kelp and abyss-bloom nectar hold a pocket of living current in the lungs.
Alchemy Stand: 1 x Water Bottle, 2 x Starfern Frond, 1 x Lumenreed Frond, 1 x Moonpetal produces 1 x Verdant Renewal. Starfern and living Lumenreed knit cuts with a cool, clean pulse.
Alchemy Stand: 1 x Water Bottle, 2 x Moonberry, 1 x Glow Scale produces 1 x Wayskip Draught. Banks one stable journey to a known POI, bed spawn, or wayshrine.
